findings.desc: doc-code-drift: §2.2 FINDING schema declares severity as BLOCKER|MAJOR|MINOR, but §4.2 flow feeds confirmed Findings into finding_add, which only accepts severity critical|high|medium|low (cli/command-catalog.ts:1451, core/types.ts:532 Finding interface). BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR are not valid Lattice Finding severity values and would cause a Zod validation error at finding_add call time. The spec schema should either (a) use the actual Lattice severity enum critical|high|medium|low, or (b) explicitly state this is a methodological label layer that maps to Lattice severity before finding_add is called.
findings.resolvedReason: §4.2 LEDGER-MAPPING subsection added: BLOCKER->critical/MAJOR->high/MINOR->medium; abstract methodology severity never reaches finding_add. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: §2.3 Verdict schema declares agreedSeverity as BLOCKER|MAJOR|MINOR|NOT_A_DEFECT. This is the same severity-label mismatch as §2.2: Lattice finding_add uses critical|high|medium|low, not BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR. Additionally, NOT_A_DEFECT is introduced in §2.3 without being part of the Finding severity enum. If Verdict.agreedSeverity is ever stored or mapped to a finding_add call, the BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR values cannot be passed directly. The spec needs to either use the Lattice severity vocabulary or explicitly define the translation layer between its methodological labels and Lattice severity values.

Codex MAJOR (lane list wrong): the spec names lattice-review-scope/test/delivery as REVIEW lanes, but review_run_start supports concept/quality/test-coverage/behavior/docs/channel; scope-plan + delivery are PLAN/DONE artifacts not review_run lanes. Fix §4.1/§5: use the actual supported REVIEW lanes, map each lens to one, describe scope-plan/delivery as separate PLAN/DONE artifacts (or mark a new completeness lane as FUTURE).
findings.resolvedReason: §4.1 lists the 6 real review_run_start lanes; §4.2 lens->lane table; scope-plan/delivery described as PLAN/DONE artifacts not REVIEW lanes. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: Codex MAJOR (critic data-flow contradiction): §2.4 says critic input={change,confirmedFindings} but §3.2 runs the critic BEFORE verifying raw lens findings and §4.2 shows verify/finding_add before the critic — contradictory, loop unbuildable. Fix: one canonical order (run lenses -> verify lens raw findings -> pass confirmed to critic -> verify critic findings -> converge/reopen) and make §2.4/§3.2/§4.2 consistent.
findings.resolvedReason: one canonical loop order frozen + made identical in §2.4/§3.2/§4.2: lenses->verify lens findings->critic on confirmed->verify critic findings->converge/reopen. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: Codex MAJOR (verifier rule not majority): M=2 with >=1 confirm is NOT a majority, conflicting with the default-refute/majority-confirm contract. Fix: define majority mechanically (confirmations >= floor(M/2)+1) OR rename to 'threshold/one-confirm' and make all language + S2 acceptance consistent with the chosen quorum.
findings.resolvedReason: ledger mapping incl. {title,issue,fix}->desc + file->files[] + category + reviewRunId + agent. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: Codex MAJOR (full-3x2 over-specified): stated as claude-code host + codex host, but the protocol is '3 rounds x 2 INDEPENDENT PASS hosts' with identity/material/session/key bindings; provider names are diagnostic/example. Fix §4: define full-3x2 abstractly (3 rounds x 2 independent hosts + the binding requirements); use Claude+Codex only as THIS review's example.
findings.resolvedReason: renamed to threshold-confirm (NOT majority), default T=1-of-2, consistent in §2.3/§4.4/§5 S2. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: Codex+docs MAJOR (Finding schema not wired to finding_add): §2.2/§2.3 use severity BLOCKER|MAJOR|MINOR and fields file/line/issue/fix, but finding_add expects critical|high|medium|low + desc + category + optional files + reviewRunId. §4/S4 says confirmed findings flow to finding_add but defines no mapping. Fix §2.2/§4.2: add an explicit ledger mapping (BLOCKER->critical/MAJOR->high/MINOR->medium-or-low; file+line+issue+fix -> desc + files; category selection; reviewRunId/agent attribution) — keep the abstract methodology severity but document the conversion at the integration boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: §4.3 MVP critic provenance: main agent runs the critic, records confirmed findings via finding_add under an existing lane with --agent completeness-critic; reopen=normal DEV->REVIEW; dedicated lane FUTURE. commit 308f3d556.

findings.desc: Codex MAJOR (MVP critic has no ledger provenance): the critic is 'always present' and can reopen rounds, but the dedicated lattice-review-completeness lane is FUTURE and no MVP agent/lane/artifact is defined for confirmed critic findings (reviewer-evidence logic only counts supported lattice-review-* lanes). Fix §4.3/§4.4: define MVP critic provenance — either make a completeness lane MVP, OR map critic findings to a supported lane with clear attribution, OR a separate local reopen-signal/artifact; mark anything not available today as FUTURE.
findings.resolvedReason: §4.1/§4.3/§5 S4 define full-3x2 abstractly (3 rounds x 2 independent PASS hosts + identity/material bindings); Claude+Codex as example only. commit 308f3d556.
